description: Parses queries like "90 business days from today in uganda" into a normalized operation, answers it, and returns the auditable receipt. Ambiguous dates (03/04/2027) return needsClarification instead of a guess.

locale.description: Resolves ambiguous slash dates; omit to receive clarification choices

q.description: The date question in plain language. Pass the user's wording rather than a date you computed.

tz.description: IANA timezone that defines "today" (e.g. Africa/Kampala). Default UTC.

name: parse_date_query

answer.description: The calculated answer, absent when parsed is null

canonicalUrl.description: tilwhen page that answers this query, to cite; null when no page covers it

confidence.description: 1.0 is a clean grammar hit; below 0.5 the query is refused rather than guessed

needsClarification.description: Present when the query is genuinely ambiguous (e.g. 03/04/2027); offers explicit choices instead of a guess

parsed.description: Normalized operation, or null when the query could not be understood confidently

receipt.description: Auditable receipt, absent when parsed is null

warnings.description: Machine-readable notes, e.g. unsupported_unit or time_ignored

title: Parse a natural-language date question
